event.summary: A shooting in an apartment building in downtown Minneapolis has left two people dead and several others injured, including three police officers. The incident occurred when a gunman opened fire, prompting an ongoing investigation by local authorities.

timeline.title: Suspect in Minneapolis Shooting Identified as Facing Eviction
timeline.summary: Carlton Neal Johnson II has been identified as the suspect in a mass shooting at a downtown Minneapolis apartment building, which occurred on Wednesday. Reports indicate that he was facing eviction due to a series of incidents, including assault and allegedly brandishing a firearm to management.
